name: Lila Morillo
scope: Independent audit of Lila only. No shared runtime or art changes.

sources.workingTreeEngine: Shared engine is an untracked current task file; audit covers its actual contents, including staged input/contact/physics symmetry.
sources.research: Preserved local dossier; no new broad web research. Long reddish dark hair, fringe, gold jewelry and embroidered stage adaptation remain supported. Generic wordless reaction policy is retained.

validation.engine: Real shared engine, deterministic 60 Hz match stepping, no mocks.

movement.setup: Poliedro; finish 510-tick intro; Lila x=540, rival x=920, floor y=554.
movement.inputs: Right held 24 steps, then left held 24; release 10; jump once and advance 10; second and third jump edges one step apart; advance 100.
movement.result: Correct movement facing in each direction. Two jumps allowed, third rejected; returns to floor, grounded with zero used jumps and both stocks. Both player sides produce the same movement evidence.

ordinaryAttacks.setup: After intro, Lila x=180 / 900; Javier x=260 / 820; energy=100. One light or heavy edge; advance 8 / 13 steps, then 40 more.
ordinaryAttacks.result: Each attack contacts once. Frontal guard blocks without HP damage. Knockback follows attacker-to-target direction on both sides.

special.name: Abanico del cocotero
special.setup: Poliedro; complete intro; Lila x=180 / 900, Javier x=460 / 620, both y=554 and energy=100. Increment Lila special once and step 140 frames. Tick values below are relative to intro completion, and shared hitstop does not advance state.tick.

rearGuard.input: Rival block plus right when Lila is P1; block plus left when Lila is P2

special.mirroredResult: Equal HP, hit counts, block counts and impact ticks on both sides; knockback changes sign correctly.
special.energyGate: 24 starting energy rejects special on either side.
special.airborneProbe: At gap 140, rival jumps, 12 steps pass, then Lila specials: two hits, HP 86.65119999999999 on both sides; rival ultimately lands at y=554.
special.expiration: All projectiles expire or connect by the 140-step end of every probe. No non-finite positions or lingering shots. The five trajectories are emitted together; existing post-hit invulnerability explains why five emitted leaves do not imply five guaranteed hits.

combos.gateProbe: At gap 140, send light, advance 23, light, advance 23, heavy, advance 11. Whiff history recognition follows existing design.

connectedBase.inputs: Light then heavy, chase into <=80 range between attacks

connectedAdvanced.inputs: Light, light, heavy; one win; chase into <=80 range between attacks

super.name: Gran cocotero
super.rejected: Wins 0/2 at 100 energy, and wins 3 at 74 energy

cpuBout.setup: Lila P1 x=180, Javier P2 x=600, wins=3 and energy=100 after intro.
cpuBout.driver: Exact chase, block, jump and attack input loop is preserved in cpuFight() in the audit test. Lila opens with one special; pursuit begins after step 180.
cpuBout.deterministicReplay: A second fresh match runs the same complete input driver and deep-equals the entire returned state, started attacks and landed attacks.

presentation.name: Saludo de diva
presentation.codeAndEngineChecks: Selection progress clamps at 1 at both 2800 and 5600 ms. Intro/selection sampled endpoints use frame 1 and do not restart. All eight frameFacing values are 1; normalized facing preserves either requested side. Whole intro blocks movement/attack, and at tick 510 enters playing facing the rival on either player side.
presentation.nativeMethodAttempted: Own fresh native tab after host recovery (reuseExistingTab=false), explicit tabId on every operation. Imported real assets.ts and presentation-renderer.ts. Saved and viewed right/left eight-frame sheets, then intro and selection sheets at progress 0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9, 1 and 2 on both facings.
presentation.localAtlasInspection: Viewed real public/assets/lila-v15.webp via local image viewer: eight distinct intact poses, dark reddish hair with fringe, gold jewelry, black/gold embroidery and gold boots. Native renderer visuals subsequently confirmed both facings.
presentation.atlasQa: Existing sprite QA passes source PNG and runtime WebP at 1774x887, eight components in two rows of four.
presentation.transientHistory: Renderer import initially failed with TypeError: Failed to fetch dynamically imported module and network net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED during shared server restart. The subsequent fresh navigation returned PreviewAutomationNoAvailableHostError: No preview automation host is available for navigate in environment 39104cbf-8b46-4a53-bc85-a1f2f3b750e4. Host instructions said Do not retry. No native screenshot or animated visual pass is claimed. Parent confirmed host recovery; one fresh native tab subsequently succeeded and completed all visual checks.
presentation.visualObservations: All eight combat sprites retain intact main silhouettes, consistent likeness, correct left/right mirroring and clean feet; no neighboring shoe fragments. Intro/selection salute changes pose during its authored interval, faces the rival in either direction and holds the exact guard after completion. Static samples confirm start/action/end progression; engine timeline and progress clamping establish one-shot behavior.

browserPixelChecks.method: For each kind/facing, offscreen real renderer outputs at progress 1 and 2 are byte-identical PNG data URLs; endpoint also exactly equals drawSprite combat guard frame 1, while midpoint 0.3 differs from endpoint.

followUp: None required by completed checks. No reproducible combat or presentation defect found.
